name: Zero One Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zero One Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides enterprise information technology solutions in Taiwan and internationally. The company designs, manufactures, packages, and sells electronic information, computer software, hardware, accessories, components, Chinese data processing, and others, as well as consulting services. It also engages in IT infrastructure; network and information security; cloud platform and application; big data application; artificial intelligence; investment activities; commodities trading; and technical services. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
